The present disclosure relates to a super-junction structure, a method for manufacturing the super-junction structure and a semiconductor device including the super-junction structure. The super-junction structure includes an epitaxy layer of a first doping type and a plurality of first pillar regions of a second doping type which are formed in the epitaxy layer and are separated from each other. Each of the first pillar regions has a doping concentration that decreases from bottom to top. A portion of the epitaxy layer between adjacent ones of the first pillar regions is a second pillar region. The first pillar regions and the second pillar region are arranged alternatively to form the super-junction structure. The first pillar regions are characterized by the doping concentration that decreases from bottom to top so that the super-junction structure has a relatively high breakdown voltage and a relatively low on resistance. Moreover, the super-junction structure changes a path of an avalanche current and thus suppresses an avalanche current so that the device is not easily damaged.

This disclosure concerns a super-junction structure, a process for producing the super-junction structure, and a semiconductor device incorporating the super-junction structure. The super-junction structure comprises an epitaxial layer having a first conductivity doping type, together with multiple first pillar regions having a second conductivity doping type. These first pillar regions are formed within the epitaxial layer and are spaced apart from one another.

In each first pillar region, the dopant concentration gradually becomes lower in the direction from the bottom toward the top. The part of the epitaxial layer located between neighboring first pillar regions serves as a second pillar region. The first pillar regions and the second pillar region are positioned in an alternating arrangement, thereby forming the super-junction structure.

Because the dopant concentration of the first pillar regions decreases upward from the bottom, the super-junction structure can achieve both a comparatively high breakdown voltage and a comparatively low on-resistance. In addition, the structure modifies the flow route of avalanche current, thereby reducing the avalanche current and making the device less susceptible to damage.

The disclosure relates to a super-junction structure, a method for manufacturing the super-junction structure, and a semiconductor device incorporating the super-junction structure.

The super-junction structure includes an epitaxy layer having a first doping type. Within the epitaxy layer, a plurality of separated first pillar regions having a second doping type are formed. The first doping type and the second doping type are opposite conductivity types; for example, one may be N-type and the other may be P-type.

Each of the first pillar regions is configured with a graded doping concentration. Specifically, the doping concentration of each first pillar region decreases in a direction from the bottom of the pillar region toward the top of the pillar region. In other words, the lower portion of each first pillar region has a relatively higher doping concentration, while the upper portion has a relatively lower doping concentration.

The portions of the epitaxy layer located between adjacent first pillar regions function as second pillar regions. These second pillar regions have the first doping type and are arranged alternately with the first pillar regions of the second doping type. Together, the alternating first and second pillar regions form the super-junction structure.

By providing the first pillar regions with a doping concentration that gradually decreases from bottom to top, the electric field distribution within the super-junction structure can be optimized. This graded doping profile helps improve the breakdown voltage of the device while also reducing on-resistance. In addition, the graded profile changes the path of avalanche current during breakdown or high-voltage operation, thereby helping to suppress localized damage and improve the reliability of the semiconductor device.
outputs.L4:
A super-junction semiconductor structure includes a semiconductor substrate and an epitaxial layer formed on the substrate. Within the epitaxial layer, a plurality of first-conductivity-type epitaxy regions are arranged alternately with a plurality of second-conductivity-type pillar regions. The first-conductivity-type epitaxy regions may, for example, be N-type drift regions, while the second-conductivity-type pillar regions may be P-type pillars, although the conductivity types may be reversed depending on the device design.

Each second-conductivity-type pillar region is separated from adjacent pillar regions by the first-conductivity-type epitaxy regions, thereby forming a charge-balanced super-junction structure. The second-conductivity-type pillar regions extend generally in a vertical direction through at least a portion of the epitaxial layer. In each pillar region, the dopant concentration is not uniform, but is instead graded so that the dopant concentration is relatively high near a lower portion of the pillar region and gradually decreases toward an upper portion of the pillar region. In other words, the pillar regions have a bottom-to-top doping gradient.

This graded doping profile improves the electric-field distribution in the drift region when the device is in an off-state. By properly balancing the charge between the first-conductivity-type epitaxy regions and the second-conductivity-type pillar regions, the semiconductor structure can sustain a high reverse voltage before breakdown occurs. The reduced dopant concentration near the upper portions of the pillar regions helps prevent excessive electric-field crowding near the device surface or near junction termination regions, while the higher dopant concentration near the lower portions of the pillar regions supports charge compensation deeper in the drift region.

As a result, the super-junction structure provides a high breakdown voltage while maintaining a low specific on-resistance. During forward conduction, the first-conductivity-type epitaxy regions provide low-resistance current paths, allowing current to flow efficiently through the drift region. Because the super-junction design permits higher drift-region doping than a conventional uniformly doped drift layer for the same breakdown voltage, the on-resistance of the device can be significantly reduced.

The graded second-conductivity-type pillar regions also influence the behavior of avalanche current during high-voltage stress. When avalanche breakdown begins, the non-uniform doping profile helps redirect avalanche current away from vulnerable regions of the device, such as the gate oxide, body junction, surface termination, or other localized high-field areas. By distributing the electric field more evenly and guiding avalanche current into more robust portions of the semiconductor structure, localized heating and current concentration can be suppressed.

Accordingly, the graded pillar design enhances device ruggedness and reliability. The structure is particularly useful in power semiconductor devices, such as super-junction MOSFETs, insulated-gate devices, diodes, and other high-voltage switching devices. By combining charge-balanced alternating conductivity regions with a vertically decreasing pillar dopant concentration, the device achieves a desirable combination of high breakdown voltage, low on-resistance, improved avalanche capability, and enhanced robustness under demanding operating conditions.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for a semiconductor super-junction structure with alternating doped pillar regions, where the first pillar regions have a doping concentration that decreases from bottom to top, improving breakdown voltage and on-resistance while suppressing avalanche current.
counterfactuals.output: A semiconductor device includes a super-junction structure having a plurality of alternating first and second doped pillar regions of opposite conductivity types extending in a vertical direction in a semiconductor body. Each first doped pillar region has a dopant concentration profile that decreases from a lower portion toward an upper portion of the pillar region. The graded dopant concentration provides enhanced charge balance between adjacent pillar regions during reverse bias operation, thereby increasing breakdown voltage while maintaining reduced on-resistance during forward conduction. The reduced dopant concentration near an upper region of the first pillar regions further suppresses localized electric-field crowding and avalanche current generation. The super-junction structure may be incorporated in a vertical power semiconductor device, such as a MOSFET, diode, or insulated gate device, to provide improved high-voltage blocking capability and conduction performance.

counterfactuals.prompt: Summarize the following invention in formal patent language: a super-junction device formed in an epitaxial layer with separated pillars of opposite doping type, alternating pillar regions, graded doping concentration from bottom to top, and improved avalanche robustness.
counterfactuals.output:
A semiconductor power device is provided comprising a semiconductor substrate and an epitaxial semiconductor layer disposed thereon. The epitaxial layer includes a super-junction structure having a plurality of laterally spaced pillar regions of a first conductivity type and a plurality of pillar regions of a second, opposite conductivity type arranged in an alternating pattern. The respective pillar regions are separated from one another and extend generally vertically through at least a portion of the epitaxial layer.

At least one of the alternating pillar regions has a dopant concentration profile that varies along a vertical direction from a lower portion of the epitaxial layer toward an upper portion thereof. In particular, the dopant concentration may be graded from a relatively higher concentration at a bottom region to a relatively lower or otherwise different concentration at a top region, thereby providing charge compensation between adjacent opposite-conductivity pillars while controlling electric-field distribution during reverse blocking operation.

The graded doping configuration in the super-junction pillars reduces localized electric-field crowding and improves breakdown behavior. As a result, the device exhibits enhanced avalanche robustness, increased breakdown stability, and improved reliability under high-voltage or unclamped inductive switching conditions, while maintaining reduced specific on-resistance characteristic of super-junction devices.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a technical disclosure paragraph for a semiconductor device including a super-junction structure, its manufacturing method, and the benefit of graded first pillar doping concentration for high breakdown voltage, low on resistance, and reduced device damage.
counterfactuals.output: A semiconductor device may include a semiconductor substrate and a drift region having a super-junction structure formed therein, the super-junction structure including a plurality of first-conductivity-type first pillars and a plurality of second-conductivity-type second pillars alternately arranged in a lateral direction. In some embodiments, the first pillars are formed with a graded dopant concentration in a depth direction and/or a lateral direction, such that a dopant concentration of each first pillar varies gradually rather than abruptly between adjacent portions of the pillar. A method of manufacturing the semiconductor device may include forming trenches in an epitaxial semiconductor layer, introducing dopants of the first conductivity type and/or the second conductivity type by implantation, epitaxial growth, diffusion, or a combination thereof, and controlling implantation energy, dose, epitaxial dopant flow, or thermal diffusion conditions to provide the graded dopant concentration in the first pillars. The graded first pillar dopant profile improves charge balance between the first and second pillars and moderates electric-field crowding in the super-junction region during reverse bias, thereby increasing breakdown voltage. At the same time, the graded concentration permits a relatively high effective carrier concentration in current-conduction portions of the drift region, reducing specific on-resistance. By smoothing the electric-field distribution and suppressing localized high-field regions near pillar interfaces, trench corners, or junction termination regions, the graded first pillar doping concentration also reduces avalanche-induced stress, leakage, and crystal or oxide damage, thereby improving device reliability.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Create a patent abstract describing a super-junction structure in which first pillar regions embedded in an epitaxial layer have vertically decreasing doping concentration, thereby altering avalanche current paths and improving reliability.
